title: Mandatory Signer IID reduces SCHC authenticated tile ceiling from 187 to 179 bytes
description: The SCHC profile derives TILE_SIZE=187 from a 255-byte signed Extended-unicast frame while omitting the mandatory 8-byte SIID field. With LENGTH max254, fixed body is LLSec/EPO/SEQ 4 + DST8 + SIID8 + Schnorr48 =68, leaving 186 L2 payload bytes; dispatch leaves a 185-byte fragment envelope. Final header15 + RCS32 + one padding bit consumes 6 bytes, so the fixed tile maximum is 179, and the two-window packet ceiling is 126*179=22,554 bytes. Update specs, Python/Rust constants/code/tests/vectors and all max-frame arithmetic; keep C/Zephyr untouched this session.
notes: Correctness reviewer found Rule255 vector limits also stale. Exact signed Extended+SIID budget: L2 payload 186, dispatch 1, Rule255 ID 1, so raw IPv6 max is 184 and SCHC packet limit is 185. Update rule255_fallback_max_single_frame and rule255_no_fragmentation plus consumers.
